source_refs.note: Unnumbered topic Working Together Online under 9.3 as printed (PDF 129, printed 125).

blocks.text: Working together online allows teams to share ideas, exchange feedback, and complete tasks without being in the same location. It promotes cooperation and creativity through shared access to documents, discussions, and resources. Students understand that clear communication and mutual respect are key to successful online teamwork. Learning to collaborate digitally prepares them for modern workplaces where remote work is common. Online teamwork encourages problem solving and builds essential interpersonal skills.

blocks.title: Do You Know?
blocks.text: Teams that communicate clearly finish tasks faster and make fewer mistakes
